# Shree Hanuman Chalisa

This is a small static reader for the complete Hanuman Chalisa.

The app includes:
- Two opening dohas, forty chaupais, and one closing doha.
- Devanagari text, IAST transliteration, and English meaning.
- Native share support through the platform share sheet where available.
- Offline support through a service worker.
- Home-screen install metadata for iOS and Android.

Canonical URL: https://chiragmirani.github.io/hanuman-chalisa/
Source text reference: https://wiki.yoga-vidya.de/Hanuman_Chalisa_Text
